sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a most recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position with seven wins from their last six games (excluding the latest defeat), and will be heavy favourites against struggling Alsager Town, who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once in their last five outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to bounce back from their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth in the table—a significant contest in the title race, with both sides having stumbled recently (AFC Bridgnorth on a two-loss run before their win). Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in good form with three consecutive wins, face Wednesfield Community at home; the visitors have shown patchy form but drew with Brereton Social midweek. Bilston Town, sixth-placed and unbeaten in their last three, host Foley Meir, who are struggling after consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town (10th) entertain New Mills (8th) in a fixture between sides with inconsistent recent form. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to in-form Crewe, who won their most recent match. Shawbury United face Barnton at home; Shawbury are in dire form with six consecutive losses, while Barnton sit mid-table and have won their last two. Brereton Social (bottom half, three-loss stretch) visit Widnes Town (bottom of the table with just 2 points) on Saturday—the basement clash. Later in the week, on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture between struggling sides.
